intro1.message: Oh! Um, you must be the one Sylvie wrote about. I'm Wick, and I look after the animals here. Well... there aren't any now, but that's still what I do.

introHerd.message: The sap got them, the winter before last. I still keep the tack oiled, though, because somebody should, and... well, just in case.

default.message: Um, did you need something? I'm only sorting labels, so it's no trouble.

aboutWick.message: I'm the drover, and the tanner's boy as well. The pelts go into, um, saddle blankets, and the fangs go on the fence. As charms, I mean.

aboutWickCharms.message: The fangs keep things away from the fence, or at least I think they do. I put a label on each one, so I know which ones I've already tried.

orderOffer.message: Um, I could use a few things, if you can get them. They're for the tack and the charms, mostly. If you say yes, it'll all be in your quest panel, so you don't have to remember it.

orderProgress.message: It's all in your quest panel, what I asked for. There's no rush. Well... maybe a little.

orderComplete.message: Oh! That's... that's exactly right, thank you. I'll get these labelled straight away. Could you come back in two hours, if that's all right?
